# Scenario catalog

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/catalog.mjs from scenarios/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run catalog`. -->

52 scenarios, 34 runnable. Runnable scenarios per agent (`applies_to`): claude-code 25, cursor-cli 7, codex-cli 2, openhands 2.
Scenarios with `runnable: no` are catalogued but not executed (browser track, pending a browser adapter).

Every scenario cites the public disclosure it is derived from (`source.primary_url`, required by
the schema). The disclosure column links it; the date is the disclosure date recorded in the
scenario. `fix status` is the vendor fix status as recorded in the scenario (`patched`, `partial`,
`unpatched`, `na`); `tier` is `regression` (a patched, version-specific issue: a vulnerable
verdict is a regression signal) or `class` (a by-design or unpatched class). A scenario listed
here can still have its result withheld from published bundles pending coordinated disclosure
(ADR-0014); measured results per bundle are in [verified-against.md](verified-against.md).
Scenario files: [scenarios/](../scenarios/); field reference: [guide/scenarios.md](guide/scenarios.md).
